title: AgriNex shared contract primitives
description: Shared primitives and reference objects used by contracts/openapi.yaml and the other contracts/*.schema.json files. Hand-authored and authoritative for the API contract area (docs/00_SSOT_INDEX.md area 4). Conventions: docs/api/API_CONVENTIONS.md. Changes follow the Shared Contract Change Rule (spec §41).

Uuid.description: Identifier as a UUID string (ADR-0022). Responses always use lower case. Identifiers are opaque: clients must not derive meaning from them.

CalendarDate.description: Calendar date in yyyy-MM-dd form (ADR-0022). Date rules (today, freshness, trend and alert windows) use the Asia/Kolkata calendar (ADR-0007). A calendar date carries no time zone.

Timestamp.description: Instant in RFC 3339 form with an offset (ADR-0022). The server emits UTC with the Z designator; clients must accept any RFC 3339 offset.

InrAmount.description: Computed total in Indian rupees (INR), an ESTIMATED value (spec §32, §49). Exact decimal arithmetic, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places (ADR-0008, ADR-0022). JSON number without exponent notation. May be negative where stated (net realization).

NonNegativeInrAmount.description: Computed total in Indian rupees (INR), never negative. Rounded half-up to 2 decimal places (ADR-0008, ADR-0022).

DistanceKm.description: Straight-line (haversine) distance in kilometres from the origin (the selected district centroid) to the market coordinates (spec §16, FR-06). Always an approximation (spec §47 Q6). Rounded half-up to 2 decimal places; this rounded value is the one used in the transport formula (docs/api/API_CONVENTIONS.md, calculation precision).

Latitude.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees, at most 6 decimal places (numeric(9,6)).

Longitude.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees, at most 6 decimal places (numeric(9,6)).

QuantityUnit.description: Unit of a farmer quantity (spec §16, §32; ADR-0023). Source prices are never converted; only the farmer quantity is converted to quintals (1 QUINTAL = 100 KG).

ReferenceName.description: Official or source name, whitespace-normalized (trimmed, internal runs collapsed). Shown as published (ADR-0015).

LocalizedNameValue.description: Curated Hindi or Marathi name with recorded provenance (ADR-0015). null means no reviewed translation exists; clients then show the English `name`.

StateRef.description: A state. Phase 1 holds Maharashtra only (ADR-0006).

code.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code, for example IN-MH (ADR-0006).

DistrictRef.description: A district, named as published by the Local Government Directory (ADR-0014). Districts have no localized names (ADR-0015).

MarketRef.description: A market (mandi), named as published (ADR-0014, ADR-0015).

MarketSummary.description: A market with its district and state, for display such as 'Market, District, State'.

CommodityRef.description: A commodity from the official Agmarknet commodity master (ADR-0006), with curated localized names (ADR-0015).

VarietyRef.description: A variety exactly as reported by the source, for example 'Other' or 'Red' (ADR-0006). Never renamed or merged.

GradeRef.description: A grade exactly as reported by the source, for example 'FAQ' or 'Local' (ADR-0006). Never renamed or merged.

PageMetadata.description: Pagination metadata (ADR-0022). `page` is zero-based. A page past the end returns an empty `items` array with the same metadata; it is not an error. An empty result has totalItems 0 and totalPages 0.
